Editorial Integrity & Consumer Advocacy

About Price Drop Radar

Price Drop Radar was founded on a simple premise: helping consumers make confident, data-backed buying decisions on high-ticket equipment without paying full retail price.

Our Mission

Unlike generic coupon sites that list thousands of low-quality clearance items, Price Drop Radar focuses exclusively on verified 90-day historic lows on premium, top-rated products ($200 to $2,500+) across Smart Home, Off-Grid Solar/Power Tools, and Maker/3D Printing tech.

How We Verify Deals

1.
Continuous 24/7 Price Monitoring: Our automated data pipeline tracks price fluctuations, coupon clippings, and Lightning Deals across verified manufacturers.
2.
90-Day Historic Benchmark: A deal is only flagged if it drops $\ge 15\%$ below its 90-day moving average or reaches an all-time low.
3.
Editorial Review: We strictly reject products with suspicious review profiles or high return rates, ensuring you only see hardware worth owning.
